name: Brodgar.io Options Test
author: brodgar
description: The standing end-to-end harness for hafen.client:options() (spec 018) — the client-settings surface the Options window edits, plus the hotkey registry, in one addon so that 'hello' does not have to grow another whole feature demo. It reads all five subsystems (interface / video / audio / camera / keybindings) at OnLoad, on the LOGIN SCREEN, where video() and audio() legitimately answer nil because their backing systems are built with the client UI, and again at OnEnterWorld where every value is real — the two dumps side by side ARE the 'before the client is up' rule from the docs. Every write it performs is a NON-DESTRUCTIVE ROUND-TRIP: read the current value, write a different one, read it back to prove it stuck, then restore the original, logging all three steps — so running the harness never leaves your real settings changed (and 'scale' is never written at all, since it is the one interface option a restart gates). READ-ONLY in the permission sense: it declares no permissions, nothing it does reaches the server, so it is default-enabled and needs no consent dialog. Everything is on demand behind ':opttest <sub>' — dump (read every subsystem), write (the round-trips: posGran, angGran, lightLimit, uiVolume, camera inversion), chain (several setters in one statement, proving a setter returns its subsystem handle), keys (register/get/set/list/unregister, including reading a built-in binding like 'inv' and the addon/<id>/<name> ids list() reports), error (pcall's scale(-1), lightingMode('fancy') and a set() on an unknown name, showing each fails LOUDLY instead of silently doing nothing). It registers one hotkey, 'ping', which — like every addon hotkey (D-047) — starts UNBOUND: suggested key Ctrl+Shift+O, which YOU assign in Options > Keybindings > Brodgar.io Options Test. The hotkey is bridge-owned: :reload or disable tears it down and re-registering picks your assigned key back up.
